checks.detail: All 18 required core object contracts are implemented and declared in the core schema.
Workers, scheduling and physical output roots are excluded from ResearchRunSpec semantic identity.
Synthetic and replay modes share PopulationSpec and downstream run contracts; provenance requirements differ.
AuthorityBinding records owner-programme decisions only; package import has no authority effect.
Scientific null/status vocabulary is not included in execution status vocabulary.
Outcome/ABCD future profiles are unregistered until stage contracts exist.
No real data are resolved or executed by WP1.
